title: 'We must change everything': French far-left leader Mélenchon launches presidential programme
summary: Veteran leftist Jean-Luc Mélenchon formally announced his plan to raise France's minimum wage, cap prices for essential foods and restore the country's retirement age to 60 in a speech launching his 2027 presidential election programme on Saturday.
